In order to evaluate the quality of generated data, we also present human evaluations on the data-pair quality of generated Spider and MBPP datasets. We randomly sample 100 examples from SYMGEN for both datasets and manually review the sampled data.
guideline: The reviewers checked the correctness of the generated data pairs and identified common issues: ambiguous and under-specified questions, meaninglessly complex answers, and difficulties in verification.
Manual review of generated examples for correctness and quality.

We found 81 and 79 examples are correct for MBPP and Spider, respectively. ... However, there are mainly three issues that exist in the data generated by SYMGEN in both MBPP and Spider. First, SYMGEN may generate ambiguous and under-specified questions... Secondly, the answers sometimes can be meaninglessly complex... Thirdly, it can be difficult to verify the correctness...
